title: KSEPSP [Vanilla CIT]
description: Over 1700 custom items to vanilla game!
body:
![ksepsp logo description ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2b0599e83cff9cd3786053ea35aaf99c77cce7a8.png)

![ksepsp mini logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e2dabf7c2ff780ee2b5136525a0222e7445b7019.png) **KSEPSP** is a resourcepack that adds a bunch of new items for decorating your builds, customizing gameplay or role-playing. All items can be obtained by renaming specific items on anvil. List of all items can be found on project's [website](https://definitelyawhale.github.io/ksepsp_website/).

Some features **require** modifications [![optifine logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/01bad20b8007a0ac2acc27d0d4ee4659c08e878f.png) **Optifine**](https://optifine.net/downloads), or [**ETF**](https://modrinth.com/mod/entitytexturefeatures) and [**EMF**](https://modrinth.com/mod/entity-model-features).

![emotes](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/991aa2d82827835ba1d7797da4d502f5c06d9762.png) Resourcepack has its own official set of **emotions** for [**Emotecraft**](https://modrinth.com/mod/emotecraft) mod, created by SPEmotes.

To **install** the resource pack you need to copy the downloaded archive to the "resourcepacks" folder in Minecraft root folder and turn it on in the game settings.
